# espalier_images (Data Source)

All local images in the container runtime.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "espalier_images" "all" {}

output "image_names" {
  value = data.espalier_images.all.images[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) The local images ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) Digest of the image index or manifest.
- `id` (String) Fully qualified reference the runtime stores the image under.
- `name` (String) Fully qualified reference, the same as `id`.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms of the image (`os/arch[/variant]`).
